contentText: The arrest of King Charles III's brother, the former prince Andrew, is a "national earthquake" for the UK and unprecedented in the modern history of the British royal family, says France 24’s London correspondent Benedicte Paviot. Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was arrested Thursday on suspicion of misconduct during his time as a trade envoy, as UK police investigations into allegations emerging from the Jeffrey Epstein files gathered pace.
